scientific_integrity: Universal proof is a cycle-decomposition and complementary-extension argument. Finite exhaustive checks independently corroborate the formulas; independent mathematical audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Complete multipartite finite simple graphs only. Counts roots of partial identities, not all partial automorphisms. An equivalent unindexed wreath cycle-index formulation is possible; one related 2022 computational survey was not accessible in full.
title: Prescribed-power spectra and extension defects in multipartite partial-automorphism monoids
